mapper.sql:
select aci.encounter_id as encounterId, aci.id as chargeItemId,
case aci.product_table when 'med_medication_definition' then 'MEDICATION' when 'wkf_activity_definition' then 'ACTIVITY' when 'adm_device_definition' then 'DEVICE' end as feeCategoryCode,
case aci.product_table when 'med_medication_definition' then '药品' when 'wkf_activity_definition' then '诊疗' when 'adm_device_definition' then '耗材' end as feeCategoryDisplay,
def.type_code as subCategoryCode, tc.display as subCategoryDisplay, coalesce(med.name, act.name, dev.name) as productName, coalesce(med.bus_no, act.bus_no, dev.bus_no) as productCode, COALESCE(med.total_volume, dev.total_volume) AS specification, aci.quantity_value as quantityValue, aci.quantity_unit as quantityUnitDisplay, ap.id as orderingDoctorId, ap.name as orderingDocotorName, aci.enterer_id as cashierId, pr.name as cashierName, aci.occurrence_time as billDate, IF(aci.refund_id is null, 'CHARGE', 'REFUND') as tradeDirection,
IF(aci.refund_id is null, aci.base_amount, -aci.base_amount) as baseAmount, aci.unit_price as unitAmount, IF(aci.refund_id is null, aci.discount_amount, -aci.discount_amount) as discountedAmount, aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount as discountAmount, IF(aci.refund_id is null, aci.discount_amount, -aci.discount_amount) as receivableAmount, ycfu.med_chrgitm_type as insuranceTypeDisplay, ycfu.chrgitm_lv as insuranceLevelDisplay, 0.000000 as insuranceAmount, IF(aci.refund_id is null, aci.discount_amount, -aci.discount_amount) as selfPayAmount from adm_charge_item aci left join adm_charge_item_definition def on aci.definition_id = def.id and def.is_deleted = 0 left join ter_concept tc on def.type_code = tc.code and tc.code_system_id = '236' and tc.is_deleted = 0 left join med_medication_definition med on aci.product_table = 'med_medication_definition' and aci.product_id = med.id and med.is_deleted = 0 left join wkf_activity_definition act on aci.product_table = 'wkf_activity_definition' and aci.product_id = act.id and act.is_deleted = 0 left join adm_device_definition dev on aci.product_table = 'adm_device_definition' and aci.product_id = dev.id and dev.is_deleted = 0 left join adm_practitioner pr on aci.enterer_id = pr.id and pr.is_deleted = 0 left join adm_encounter_participant aep on aci.encounter_id = aep.encounter_id and aep.role_code = 'ADMITTER' and aep.is_deleted = 0 left join adm_practitioner ap on aep.practitioner_id = ap.id and ap.is_deleted = 0 left join yb_clinic_fee_upload ycfu on aci.id = ycfu.charge_item_id and ycfu.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: select count(DISTINCT e.id) from adm_encounter e left join adm_patient p on e.patient_id = p.id and p.is_deleted = 0

select e.id as encounterId, e.bus_no as busNo, p.name as patientName, o.name as registrationDepartmentName, e.start_time as encounterDate from adm_encounter e left join adm_patient p on e.patient_id = p.id and p.is_deleted = 0 left join adm_organization o on e.organization_id = o.id and o.is_deleted = 0
order by e.start_time desc, e.id desc LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT -- 1. 基准金额：正收为正，退费为负 COALESCE(SUM(IF(aci.refund_id IS NULL, aci.base_amount, -aci.base_amount)), 0) AS base_amount_total,
-- 2. 折扣金额：正收为正，退费为负 COALESCE(SUM(IF(aci.refund_id IS NULL, aci.discount_amount, -aci.discount_amount)), 0) AS discount_amount_total,
-- 3. 折后金额(需与明细逻辑保持一致，并考虑退费方向)： -- 假设明细逻辑折后金额 = base_amount - discount_amount COALESCE(SUM(IF(aci.refund_id IS NULL, aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount, -(aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount))), 0) AS discounted_amount_total,
-- 4. 应收金额：保持与明细逻辑一致 COALESCE(SUM(IF(aci.refund_id IS NULL, aci.discount_amount, -aci.discount_amount)), 0) AS receivable_amount_total,
-- 5. 实收金额 COALESCE(SUM(IF(aci.refund_id IS NULL, aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount, -(aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount))), 0) AS actual_received_amount_total,
-- 6. 医保金额 0.000000 AS insurance_amount_total,
-- 7. 自付金额 COALESCE(SUM(IF(aci.refund_id IS NULL, aci.discount_amount, -aci.discount_amount)), 0) AS self_pay_amount_total
FROM adm_charge_item aci JOIN adm_encounter e ON aci.encounter_id = e.id AND e.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_patient p ON e.patient_id = p.id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE aci.is_deleted = 0
AND e.organization_id = #{query.registrationDepartmentId}
AND ((p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%')) OR (e.bus_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%')))
AND aci.refund_id IS NULL
AND aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL
AND aci.enterer_id = #{query.cashierId}
AND aci.occurrence_time >= #{query.settlementDateFrom} AND aci.occurrence_time <= #{query.settlementDateTo}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM adm_charge_item_definition def2 WHERE def2.id = aci.definition_id AND def2.is_deleted = 0 AND def2.type_code IN
#{code}
)
AND ( (aci.product_table = 'med_medication_definition' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM med_medication_definition mdf WHERE mdf.id = aci.product_id AND mdf.is_deleted = 0
AND mdf.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.productNameKeyword}, '%')
AND mdf.bus_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.productCodeKeyword}, '%')
) ) OR (aci.product_table = 'wkf_activity_definition' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wkf_activity_definition act2 WHERE act2.id = aci.product_id AND act2.is_deleted = 0
AND act2.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.productNameKeyword}, '%')
AND act2.bus_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.productCodeKeyword}, '%')
) ) OR (aci.product_table = 'adm_device_definition' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM adm_device_definition dev2 WHERE dev2.id = aci.product_id AND dev2.is_deleted = 0
AND dev2.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.productNameKeyword}, '%')
AND dev2.bus_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.productCodeKeyword}, '%')
) ) )
